name: Infernal Pacts
summary: Thousand Sons Psykers within 6" of and visible to a Scintillating Legions unit have a 4+ invuln vs ranged attacks; a Scintillating Legions Psyker as near a Thousand Sons unit gains Cabal of Sorcerers. Cap 500/1000/1500, never Warlord.

name: Kindred Sorcery
summary: Each Command phase, pick one of three one-per-battle army buffs until your next Command phase: +6" Psychic weapon range, +1 to wound with Psychic weapons, or Devastating Wounds on Psychic weapons.

name: Flow of Magic
summary: Your Flow of Magic is your deployment zone, plus No Man's Land or the enemy zone in any phase you control at least half its objectives. Thousand Sons Psychic Attacks re-roll a Wound roll of 1, or add 1 instead while wholly within it.

name: Sorcerous Invigoration
summary: Once per turn per unit, a Thousand Sons Psyker unit (excluding Monster) heals D3 wounds after successfully manifesting a Ritual.

name: Ensorcelled Animus
summary: Sekhetar Robots attacks have Psychic. A Sekhetar Robots unit within 12" of a friendly Thousand Sons Psyker unit gets +1 WS on its melee attacks.

name: All-Seeing Mutant Hordes
summary: Tzaangors gain Battleline; while a Mutant unit shoots, enemies get +6" detection range. Exclusive Mutant-tagged detachment.

name: Warpfire Infusion
summary: Thousand Sons Vehicle attacks re-roll a Hit, Wound, and Damage roll if within 6" of a friendly Psyker (only one of the three otherwise); their Deadly Demise also triggers on a 5+ instead of only a 6 near a Psyker.

name: Warpmeld Sacrifice
summary: A targeted Tzeentch Mutant Infantry/Mounted unit can sacrifice for -1 to be wounded, or an attacking one for +1 to wound, each costing D3 mortal wounds at phase end. Tzaangors gain Battleline and +1 OC while not battle-shocked.
